TechieDesk for Windows — installing an UNSIGNED build
======================================================

This build is not signed with a code-signing certificate (REQ-FN-038c — the
owner has no certificate yet). Everything in the app works normally; what is
missing is the signature, so Windows treats it as an unrecognised app.

This is an UNPACKAGED build, not an MSIX installer. That is deliberate: an
unsigned MSIX cannot be installed by double-clicking unless you first install
and trust its certificate, whereas this build simply runs. An MSIX installer
arrives once a certificate exists.

INSTALL
-------
1. Unzip this folder anywhere you like — for example
     C:\Program Files\TechieDesk
   or somewhere under your user folder if you would rather not need
   administrator rights.

   Keep the whole folder together. TechieDesk.exe will not run on its own; the
   surrounding files are the application.

2. Run TechieDesk.exe.

3. SmartScreen will warn: "Windows protected your PC". Click "More info",
   then "Run anyway". This happens because the app is unsigned, and it stops
   once the app is signed.

   If you downloaded the zip with a browser, Windows may also mark it as
   blocked. Right-click the zip BEFORE extracting -> Properties -> tick
   "Unblock" -> OK, then extract. Unblocking after extraction does not always
   clear the flag from the extracted files.

4. Optional: right-click TechieDesk.exe -> "Pin to Start" or send a shortcut
   to your desktop. There is no Start-menu entry, because nothing was
   installed in the Windows sense — the folder IS the application.

.NET IS NOT REQUIRED
--------------------
This build is self-contained: the .NET runtime is included. You do not need to
install anything else.

YOUR DATA
---------
TechieDesk keeps everything under
    %LOCALAPPDATA%\TechieDesk
which is outside this folder. Updating the app by replacing the folder does
not touch your data.

UNINSTALL
---------
Delete the folder. To remove your data as well, also delete
%LOCALAPPDATA%\TechieDesk.
